description: The `impai-handicap` test group's first reclaims, applied to impai-handicap.json: two CORE construction kbots of seat 1 (OTA AI), one ordered to reclaim a wreck beside it, so the reclaim payout's two Difficulty sites (0x4238C4 energy, 0x423918 metal) run for an OTA AI seat, the other ordered to reclaim a radar tower of its own seat, so the reclaimed unit's credit (0x486CDA) does. The box round (7024, 1712) is dry, flat and holds no map feature (heights 80 to 85 against the sea's 75, read from the map's attribute grid), and lies far from the three seats' starts.
